children: CSL's double change at the top sets the stage for the Australian pharmaceutical company, at least into the medium term, says Citi. CSL today named Gordon Naylor as its new chair, replacing Brian McNamee from the end of March. Naylor is currently interim CEO, but will return to being a director when new CEO Deborah Waterhouse takes the reins next month. Analyst Laura Sutcliffe says Naylor's elevation to chair cements a senior leadership bench with experience across all of CSL's key commercial areas and competencies. "We do not rule out other changes in due course but expect to wait until after the CEO role is handed over, and envisage continuity via the CFO role," Citi says. It had a neutral call on CSL entering this week. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
